desc: Ideation complete: selected dirty-interval lazy column DP exploiting cursor locality and the small dimension.
Implement input parsing, beneficial transposition, column-major storage, cursor mapping, and L/R/U/D direction mapping.
Precompute all full prefix column vectors L and suffix column vectors R, including boundary vectors, and initialize the answer.
Maintain current-column dirty intervals f_valid and rv_valid, and implement ensure_L/ensure_R plus the point-update delta formula without division.
Implement combined one-pass horizontal move_right and move_left scans that finalize the needed current vector and compute the adjacent vector, then reset intervals for the new current column.
Optimize inner loops for PyPy: local variables, split loops to avoid branches, fast modular addition, and skip work when the assigned value is unchanged.
Validate the final solution against the public samples.
